assessment: Genetic variants have been strongly implicated in idiopathic scoliosis (IS), however, the list of variants that are causative of IS is not complete and the cellular and molecular mechanisms that underlie IS are poorly understood. These authors combined human genetic analysis with zebrafish experiments to produce valuable evidence that alleles that impair function of EPHA4 cause IS, thereby extending our understanding of the basis of IS. The human genetic data are quite convincing but the zebrafish work lacks some validations and details.
